name: Rural Sanitation and Decentralized Wastewater Management
description: Sustainable rural sanitation: concepts and approaches, sanitation systems and technologies, off-grid sanitation, sanitation technology selection, operation and management of sanitation provision and services, decentralized wastewater treatments (DWWM); advantages and disadvantages, site characterization for DWWM; planning for DWWM, wastewater treatment; factors to be considered while selecting technologies for DWWM; available technologies; tertiary treatment; on-site treatment systems; bioremediation and phytoremediation processes; sludge management; operation and maintenance; village industry effluent management, valorization and resource recovery from wastewater in rural areas, case studies.
